audit.whatIsWrong: tldr/winCon/report[0,1] claimed a Ryze shield ('shield the burst', 'a shield behind it'); LeBlanc called he/him in 15+ fields; cooldowns field had no digit; two bullets were tradeGood/tradeBad pasted verbatim.
audit.why: LeBlanc is she/her. Ryze has no shield. Her W Distortion is 15-10s with a 4s return window — after using it she has no escape; E Ethereal Chains is 14s and needs 1.5s tethered to root; Q Sigil marks for 3.5s and detonates on her next ability. These numbers make the punish windows concrete.
audit.corrected: Shield claims replaced with Distortion/Sigil-grounded advice, pronouns fixed, cooldowns rewritten with 15s/10s/4s/14s/11s numbers, bleed bullets replaced with roam-ward and combo-range bodies.

edits.before: - LeBlanc Distortion: matchup-defining — Dash with a four-second return window — punish the return spot, and remember she is broke after it. Check it before every step-up. - W Rune Prison is the lifeline; chip damage never gets it. - The ult answers fights, not waves.
edits.after: - LeBlanc Distortion: 15s at rank 1, 10s max, with a 4-second return window — punish the return spot; she has no escape while it recharges. - E Ethereal Chains: 14s, needs 1.5s tethered to root — sidestep it and her pick stalls. - W Rune Prison (11s) is the lifeline.
